name: source-inference-controls
cmd: set -euo pipefail; ROOT=$PWD; OUT=$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR; bun install --frozen-lockfile > "$OUT/install.log" 2>&1; bun scripts/gen-lean-library.ts > "$OUT/library-gen.log" 2>&1; bunx tsc -p research/bapa/tsconfig.proof-witness.json > "$OUT/types.log" 2>&1; BAPA_SOURCE_INFERENCE_CONTROL="$OUT/control" bun test research/bapa/proof-witness.test.ts research/bapa/source-projection.test.ts > "$OUT/tests.log" 2>&1; cd "$OUT/control"; lake build > "$OUT/lean.log" 2>&1; lake env lean BapaProof.lean >> "$OUT/lean.log" 2>&1; bun "$ROOT/scripts/lean-gate/gate.ts" "$OUT/lean.log" BapaProof.lean > "$OUT/axioms.log" 2>&1; printf '%s\n' 'fix(bapa): validate source inference witness wrappers' > "$OUT/commit-message.txt"; cd "$ROOT"; bunx @commitlint/cli --config research/egraph/historical/commitlint.config.cjs < "$OUT/commit-message.txt" > "$OUT/commitlint.log" 2>&1; rm -rf "$OUT/control/.lake"
